name: Gradient Picker
summary: React gradient picker component built with shadcn/ui, Radix UI and Tailwind CSS.
description: A component for picking solid colors, gradients and background images for shadcn/ui projects, with a live example app. The repo holds the MIT-licensed component code; GradientPage's background images are non-commercial unless a license is bought.

built with Shadcn UI, Radix UI and Tailwind CSS
